items.title: Godfrey Hirsch Interview, 1987-10-20
items.q: Stuart Allen, who was our lead singer. Stuart Allen, his name was Allen Ross.

ctx.x: It was an awful name if I remember.

She had another name and she used to record under that name when she wasn't with such and such a band, a band that she was with. And she was with us and, and Himba had an, Himba had the knack of, of giving people names. Same as Stuart Allen, who was our lead singer. Stuart Allen, his name was Allen Ross. Jewish boy. And we were doing Studebaker. And there was a, there was a fellow by the name of Joey Nash, who was a very fine singer. Was with the Himba band. And when he got the, when he got the, when he got the…
Did you tell him about being in here at P. Long's band?
